pages.title: Metal-Organic Framework
pages.text: A scaffold of copper nodes and organic struts so open that a single gram of it hides more inner surface than a football pitch. Gas soaks into it like water into a sponge. It is feather-light and full of rooms.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Supramolecular chemistry lets molecules assemble themselves. Copper ions met nanotube struts and chiral linkers in an ionic liquid, and each found its place without my help. The framework grew the way frost grows on glass.
